s: Shuttapin bemaboy tzerikim leareb bachatzerot ubo b' seipim: hammishtattepim bemaboy tzerikim leareb bachatzerot bekol chatzer sheyyesh bah b' battim. Veap al pi shehem meorabim umeshuttapim kebar, en somekin al shittup zeh bechatzer shello erebu bah, kede shello yishkechu hattinoqot shebbechatzer zo torat erub, shehare en hattinoqot makkirim mah naaseh bemaboy, veyomru "abotenu lo erebu". Abal chatzerot happetuchot zo lezo enam tzerikim leareb zo im zo, sheshshittup hammaboy mechabberan. Umetaltelin mizzo lezo ben derek hammaboy ben derek pitchehem. Veim nishtattepu bemaboy bepat — somekim alayv bachatzerot, veen tzarik leareb kol chatzer leatzmah, lepi shehattinoqot makkirim bepat shennishtattepu bah bemaboy, shemmittok shehappat hi chayye haadam, enehem teluyot bah. Velaken en nohagin akshav laasot erube chatzerot beshum chatzer sheyyesh bah battim harbeh, lepi shessomekin al hashshittup shebbebet hakkeneset hannaaseh mippat, shemmoil gam lachatzerot im muttar letaltel mehen lebet hakkeneset. Velaken nohagin litloto bebet hakkeneset, kede sheyyehe mepursam lattinoqot:

Maboy sheerebu kol chatzerot shebbo kol chatzer leatzmah, veachar kak nishtattepu kullan bammaboy beyayin o min acher sheeno pat, veshakach echad mibbene hechatzer velo ereb im bene chatzero — lo hipsid kelum, shehare kullam nishtattepu bammaboy, veal hashshittup somekin. Velo hitzriku leareb bechatzer im hashshittup ella shello leshakkeach hattinoqot, vahare erebu (bachatzerot, vegam bechatzer zo erebu) (rob bene hechatzer, umippene hammiut shello erebu lo tishtakkach torat erub). Veim shakechu kullam milleareb bachatzerot, im en maqpidin al perusatan shebbebattehem im zeh yokal mishshel zeh (keshiur b' seuddot shel erub) — hare hen kimorabin, vesomekin al hashshittup shebbammaboy beshabbat rishona bilbad.
